changes: Family and business spaces now have an AI import inbox: upload originals, choose Vault documents or paste named text, then review suggested asset and warranty details before filing.
Connect ChatGPT or Claude through Teluva’s custom MCP server. Sign in, choose one space and specific documents, let the chatbot prepare drafts, and revoke access in AI connections.
